Bentley]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{Elections in Alabama sidebar}} The '''2014 Alabama gubernatorial election''' took place on November 4, 2014, to elect the [[governor of Alabama]]. Incumbent Governor [[Robert J. Bentley]] won a second term over [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Parker Griffith]]. This was the first Alabama gubernatorial race where either [[Choctaw County, Alabama|Choctaw]] and/or [[Conecuh County, Alabama|Conecuh]] counties voted Republican. As of 2026, this is the last time [[Jefferson County, Alabama|Jefferson County]] voted Republican in any statewide election contested by a Democrat. Bentley did not complete this term; he resigned in April 2017 due to a scandal and was succeeded by fellow Republican [[Kay Ivey]]. ==Republican primary== ===Candidates=== ====Declared==== * [[Robert J.
